arguments.script: var source=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.RuleTile>("Assets/Tiles/RockTerrain/Rock.asset");var path="Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Terrain.asset";var rule=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<JumpKingRockTile>(path);if(!rule){rule=UnityEngine.ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<JumpKingRockTile>();rule.name="Terrain";rule.m_DefaultSprite=source.m_DefaultSprite;rule.m_DefaultColliderType=source.m_DefaultColliderType;rule.m_TilingRules=source.m_TilingRules;UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(rule,path);}rule.slopes=Enumerable.Range(1,4).Select(k=>(UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TileBase)UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Slope"+k+".asset")).ToArray();UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(rule);var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name.StartsWith("Jump King"));var old=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.RuleTile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Rock.asset");foreach(var pos in m.cellBounds.allPositionsWithin)if(m.GetTile(pos)==old)m.SetTile(pos,rule);m.RefreshAllTiles();m.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>().ProcessTilemapChanges();var palette=UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Jump King Fifth Palette.prefab");try{var pm=palette.GetComponentInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>();pm.SetTile(UnityEngine.Vector3Int.zero,rule);UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(palette,"Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Jump King Fifth Palette.prefab");}finally{UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(palette);}UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene());UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene());
